scenes.headline: How Hindsight remembers what the context window forgets
scenes.sub: An open agent memory that retains, recalls, and reflects
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pippin! Here's how Hindsight recalls a fact from long ago that a context window would lose.

scenes.text: Treat memory as a structured substrate the agent reasons over, with four networks that keep evidence apart from belief, not a top-k lookup on a stateless model.
scenes.say: The idea: make memory a structured thing the agent reasons over. Four networks keep what it saw apart from what it believes.

scenes.title: The usual way vs this one

left.title: RAG top-k
items: Top-k chunks in a vector store
left.say: Most agent memory is top-k chunks in a vector store, blurring what happened with what the agent thinks.

right.title: Four networks
items: Retain, recall, reflect over a graph
right.say: Hindsight splits memory into four networks and runs three operations: retain, recall, and reflect.

steps.say: Retain. An open model reads the chat and pulls out a few self-contained facts.
Each fact goes into one of four networks, wired into a graph by entity, time, and cause.
To recall, four retrievers search the bank at once: by meaning, keyword, graph links, and time.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges their lists by rank, then a cross-encoder reranks the top few.
Reflect reasons over the result, shaped by disposition traits, forming or updating an opinion.
Out comes an answer, grounded in a fact that never had to stay in the context window.

scenes.title: LongMemEval, overall accuracy
scenes.say: On the long-memory benchmark the same small model jumps from thirty-nine to eighty-three point six once Hindsight is in front.

scenes.label: points gained on LongMemEval, from the memory layer alone
scenes.say: A gain of forty-four point six points, from the memory layer alone. The model never changed.

scenes.text: The memory layer, not a bigger model, carries the win. Structure the memory and a small model reads it well.

recap: Four networks, evidence apart from belief
Retain, recall with four retrievers, reflect
scenes.say: To recap: four networks that separate evidence from belief, retain, recall, reflect, and a big jump from the memory alone.
